why: From A to B the picture is flipped like a mirror (left to right), so the black leaf jumps from the left side to the right side. C has its black leaf on the right, so after the mirror flip it must point straight to the left, with one white leaf going up and one going down. Option 4 is exactly this mirror image of C. Option 2 also has the black leaf on the left, but it points down-left, so it is not a true mirror.
trick: When the black part just changes side, think 'mirror'. Check that every leaf keeps the same angle, only flipped.
note: B has one more white leaf than A; that extra leaf is not used by the book's answer. Option 4 is taken as the mirror image of C. Option 3 has a dotted (grey) leaf in the scan.
